id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2778: "No matter how strong you've become from battle experience, don't let your guard down. That carelessness can be fatal.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|279a: "No matter how strong you've become from battle experience, don't let your guard down. That carelessness can be fatal.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2787: "If it looks dangerous, don't be stubborn, just run. Nobody will laugh at you. Life is worth more than pride.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27a9: "If it looks dangerous, don't be stubborn, just run. Nobody will laugh at you. Life is worth more than pride.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27bd: "Hey, {var:1}, well done! Defeating the monsters' boss, that's something!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27d9: "Hey, {var:1}, well done! Defeating the monsters' boss, that's something!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27c5: "Who'd have thought someone who'd save the world would come from Cobblestone! I'm as happy as if it were me!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27e1: "Actually I liked Gemma, and I felt a bit jealous after {var:1} married her.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27eb: "But now I can admit defeat honestly. Make sure you make her happy!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28a7: "Oh dear... I kept spare fishing hooks in the storehouse, but now I'll never find them.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28b4: "Even at times like this, relaxation matters. When you have no slack, you make more mistakes at work.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28c4: "The village's rebuilding finally settled down and I can spend time on myself. Ah, what peace...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28d4: "The village's rebuilding finally settled down and I can spend time on myself. Ah, what peace...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28e6: "That traveling performer who came to Cobblestone the other day was amazing. Walking the tightrope, breathing fire...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28f1: "He was your companion, wasn't he? You've got a wider circle than me now. You've grown while I wasn't looking.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2929: "The owner of the tent ahead has been bedridden with illness since the day the great tree fell.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2935: "A commotion would strain their health, so please refrain from entering.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2943: "The Cobblestone folk are kind. No one blames us for wrecking the village with cannons.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2950: "To repay their kindness even a little, I want to defend this bastion as long as I can.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|295f: "The hero's return signal appeared in the northern sky. I hope this expedition brought some result.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2971: "I may not look it, but I'm good with a crossbow. I'll shoot down every monster that attacks from the sky!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2981: "I clearly saw the monsters flee even from here! Serves them right!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|298f: "The Cobblestone folk are kind. They let us stay without blaming us for wrecking the village with cannons.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|299e: "Now that the monsters are gone, I want to rebuild Cobblestone as soon as possible and repay the villagers.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29bd: "I am a wandering warrior. When monsters attacked and all seemed lost, the hero at this bastion saved my life.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29cc: "Kindness I repay double unasked. That is the wandering warrior's way. I'll protect this bastion with my life.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29de: "I am a wandering warrior! Being alone with no one awaiting my return, I'll defend the bastion with my life!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29f1: "I am a wandering warrior! Even from inside the bastion, my keen gaze seems to have reached the monsters!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29fd: "They fled in fear back to Heliodor Castle! Ha ha ha!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a0a: "I am a wandering warrior! When shown kindness, I repay double without asking! That is the way of the wandering warrior!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a16: "Having come this far, I'll do everything I can until Heliodor is restored!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a28: "Actually, I'm from Angri-La. The stiff life didn't suit me, so I ran from home...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a35: "I'd rather not think of it, but Angri-La sits on Mount Pang Lai, near the great tree.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a42: "If I were living there now, I wouldn't be safe either.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a4f: "I am a wandering warrior. After wandering and wandering half my life, it's time to put down roots.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a5b: "When Heliodor's restoration is done, I plan to return to my hometown Angri-La and begin training as a priest.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a7e: "I don't know who named it first, but we call this place the Last Bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a89: "When the great tree of life fell, humans who lost their homes built this as their last hope to live.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a9f: "Ugh... I'm done for. A monster got my elbow. Ow ow ow...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aab: "Thanks... After a short rest, I'll fight again too!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ab8: "Even with my elbow hit by a monster, I fought desperately! Cool, right? Ow ow ow.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aca: "Knowing monsters won't come anymore, I can't help humming. If I'm happy and I know it, la la la~♪
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2adb: "The Dark One is gone and peace has come. A gloomy name like Last Bastion doesn't suit this village.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ae9: "Let's finish the rebuilding quick and restore the beautiful, peaceful Cobblestone.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b0f: "Sorry, mister. Please don't talk to me. I'll lose track of what time it is.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b38: "Sorry, mister. Please don't talk to me. I'll lose track of what time it is.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b18: "The sun is hidden by dark haze and I hate not knowing morning from night, so I decided to count time.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b41: "The sun is hidden by dark haze and I hate not knowing morning from night, so I decided to count time.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b5e: "The sun is hidden by dark haze and I hate not knowing morning from night, so I decided to count time.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b7c: "The sun is hidden by dark haze and I hate not knowing morning from night, so I decided to count time.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b25: "So I know. It's midday now, when the bright sun should be shining. It really brings me down...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b4e: "So I know. It's midnight now, when the stars should be twinkling. It really brings me down...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b6b: "...But the monsters are so scary I forgot how far I'd counted. Not knowing morning from night is unsettling...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b89: "But after that battle I forgot how far I'd counted. Not knowing morning from night is unsettling...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ba0: "When Heliodor is restored, I'm going to become a clockmaker!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bbe: "When Heliodor is restored, I'm going to become a clockmaker!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ba9: "I counted time even in that darkness, so I must have talent! Luminary, someday use my clock!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bc7: "I counted time even in that darkness, so I must have talent! Luminary, someday use my clock!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2be9: "The hero leads troops out searching for people left behind and those hurt and unable to move.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2bf8: "No matter how strong he is, fighting like that every day, he'd need nine lives.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c07: "The hero's returning... But I'm in such a dirty state, I'm too embarrassed to go welcome him... sniff.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c17: "Lord Hendrik is back, so the Last Bastion is safe now! We'll all fight hard!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c26: "Lord Hendrik scattered the monsters! As expected of our hero!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c33: "I'm not the tactless kind of woman who holds back a warrior setting out.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c4c: "I'm not the tactless kind of woman who holds back a warrior setting out.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c3a: "The hero is so strong, I believe he'll defeat the monsters and drive away the darkness.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c53: "It's very lonely that Lord Hendrik is setting out on a journey, but I'll send him off in silence...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c6b: "This is the Last Bastion. Before the great tree of life fell, it was apparently a small village called Cobblestone.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c78: "...Huh? You're from this village? Coming home in times like this, you must have missed your hometown dearly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c8a: "Lord Hendrik's personal knights fought with him in the Dundrasil tragedy sixteen years ago, mighty warriors all!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2c98: "They won't let monsters' attacks break into the bastion!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ca6: "Not letting a single monster into the bastion, I'm in awe!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cae: "Lord Hendrik's personal knights! Fighting in the Dundrasil tragedy sixteen years ago was no fluke!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cbe: "This is the Last Bastion, built by humans who lost their homes when the great tree fell, as their last hope.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cd6: "Lord {var:1}, Lord Hendrik. Please wait a moment.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cdb: "The King of Heliodor has something important to tell you both. Please hurry to the king's tent.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cea: "At the summit of Mount Pang Lai is a village called Angri-La, where priests train. Its terraced townscape was beautiful.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2cfd: "Unfortunately, Angri-La sits on a mountaintop near the great tree. That village surely isn't safe...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d0f: "Welcome back. This is the Last Bastion, a land of hope saved by two heroes.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d1f: "Welcome back, Luminary. This is the Last Bastion, a land of hope saved by two heroes.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d3e: "The day the great tree fell, dark clouds and monsters poured from Heliodor Castle and drove us from home...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d50: "Thrown into aimless darkness and nearly in despair, we were saved by the hero of the Last Bastion.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d5f: "If the Last Bastion is a land of hope, the hero guarding it is the beacon fire. ...He is our last hope.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d72: "Monsters will attack soon! When you're ready, hurry to Lord Hendrik outside the bastion!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d80: "I hear you were called to the king's tent! Perhaps you'll get a wonderful reward!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d8b: "Beyond here are the soldiers' quarters. We beat the monsters, so everyone is sleeping well for once.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2d9e: "Even if no monsters come, a gatekeeper is a gatekeeper! Holding our post is the duty of a Heliodor soldier!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2db9: "Beyond is the Last Bastion's center, with vital facilities like weapon, armor and food storage.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dcf: "If you need anything for battle, talk to Derk. His item shop is in the tent south of the village.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2de0: "Lord Hendrik returned, but he looked very grim. Why, even though we beat the monsters?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2df2: "Lord Hendrik and Lord Jasper have served the King of Heliodor since childhood and grew up as best friends.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2dfe: "The two always quarreled, but only Lord Jasper could support Lord Hendrik in battle...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e07: "With his most trusted friend missing, kind-hearted Lord Hendrik must be hurting deeply...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e1b: "We Heliodor soldiers' next mission is rebuilding Cobblestone and restoring Heliodor.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e27: "Not just Heliodor's people but all the Cobblestone folk will work together to restore the peace of old!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e47: "Some soldiers guarding this bastion were ordinary townsfolk originally.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e51: "But in times like this, anyone who can move must fight. We have to protect ourselves.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e62: "The hero has returned. He must be exhausted from constant sorties. I'd like him to rest well.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e72: "Wah, wah!! I failed to get down! Wah!!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e79: "Phew... I finally got down from the ledge. I didn't know how it would turn out.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e84: "I'm a trainer of recruits. I teach recruits from the townsfolk what a Heliodor knight should be.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2e92: "Their swordsmanship is quite good. Even if I die in battle, they'll protect the bastion in my place.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ea7: "Swordsmanship and farming use the body very similarly, so a good swordsman is also a good farmer.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2eb5: "Master swordsmanship and farming follows naturally. It solves food shortages too, two birds with one stone.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ec6: "I'm a trainer of recruits. I teach the soldiers here what a Heliodor knight should be.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ed2: "A Heliodor knight is a guardian. Never swing your sword to hurt someone.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ef2: "Want to see the King of Heliodor? Since coming to the bastion, he's been bedridden in the central tent.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2efe: "Unless it's very important, I doubt you can see him.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f0b: "Hold on, mister. Where are you going? There's nothing beyond here.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f12: "More importantly, the bastion's entrance is to the north. Dawdling here, you might miss seeing the hero!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f24: "We're Heliodor's Three Blades! They call me Mighty Knuckle! You won't escape, monster!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f34: "Phew, you saved me! Thanks! Their bones are so hard I never felt like I'd win!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f43: "Ugh, tired, tired. I want to get back to the bastion and sleep soundly.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f58: "Lord Hendrik! Don't worry about the bastion! We may be less dependable than General Jasper, but we'll guard it!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f66: "...I burden you. I will surely return to the bastion. Until then, I leave the Last Bastion to you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f73: "Y-yes! We trust you, General! Please be sure to come back!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f7e: "Wow, so cool. I feel like I could believe anything he says.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f8a: "When Heliodor is restored, we'll part with this village... It feels kind of lonely...
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2f96: "When Cobblestone's rebuilding is done, we'll part with this village. It feels a bit lonely.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fb7: "Beyond here is Cobblestone Tor. ...Huh? You know it?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fbd: "What, mister, you're from this village? With such silky hair and a dignified face?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fcb: "Monsters are at the bastion entrance, right? I'll guard Cobblestone Tor, so go help Lord Hendrik!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fdd: "...Hold on, mister. What are you doing going to Cobblestone Tor? The King of Heliodor is calling you.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2fec: "It looks like rain soon, so better not go to Cobblestone Tor. If you slip and fall, it'd be terrible.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ffd: "Oh, General Hendrik and Luminary. Even if you go to Cobblestone Tor, there's nothing beyond.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3008: "More importantly, hurry and defeat the monster that creates eternal dark, and do something about this pitch black!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3018: "Oops, Luminary. Even if you go to Cobblestone Tor, there's nothing beyond.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3021: "More importantly, the King of Heliodor is calling you both. Why not go see him first?
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|302d: "Hey, praying at Cobblestone Tor? People born in Cobblestone are devout. I'm always impressed.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|303d: "Luminary, praying at Cobblestone Tor? There's nothing there, yet Cobblestone folk are devout.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|304d: "Luminary, praying at Cobblestone Tor? There's nothing there, yet Cobblestone folk are devout.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|306f: "Wow, this kid is something! She calmed down every horse even adults couldn't handle!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3079: "She said her dad taught her horse care, so her dad must have taught well!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3088: "The hero returns soon! Hurry to the bastion entrance or you'll miss his gallant figure!!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|309f: "Strong, too strong...! The monsters on this battlefield are stronger than any enemy so far!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30aa: "A warrior's greatest mistake isn't fleeing! It's misjudging his own strength!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30b4: "If you fight the monsters here and feel you can't touch them, this battlefield is too early for you!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30c1: "The enemies in the Emerald Coast to the east are somewhat weaker, so hone your skills there and come back!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30d2: "I passed out partway and have no memory, but someone seems to have saved me... Thanks, unknown hero.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30e4: "I think Lord Hendrik's beloved horse Ritaliphon is the best horse in the world.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30fc: "I think Lord Hendrik's beloved horse Ritaliphon is the best horse in the world.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3114: "I think Lord Hendrik's beloved horse Ritaliphon is the best horse in the world.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|312c: "I think Lord Hendrik's beloved horse Ritaliphon is the best horse in the world.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3144: "I think Lord Hendrik's beloved horse Ritaliphon is the best horse in the world.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|30ec: "Faster than any horse, stronger than any horse, and above all, the smartest. I'd love to ride him just once.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3104: "Faster than any horse, stronger than any horse, and above all, the smartest. I'd love to ride him just once.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|311c: "Faster than any horse, stronger than any horse, and above all, the smartest. I'd love to ride him just once.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3134: "Faster than any horse, stronger than any horse, and above all, the smartest. I'd love to ride him just once.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|314c: "Faster than any horse, stronger than any horse, and above all, the smartest. I'd love to ride him just once.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|315a: "It won't be as fine as the old stable, but to repay this village I plan to build a new horse stable!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|316e: "Ritaliphon was in such a good mood that I knew right away the Luminary and Lord Hendrik had returned.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3177: "Please greet him before you set out on your next adventure. He'll surely wag his tail for joy!
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|3193: "If a cute maid nurses me, being injured isn't bad.
id./param/region/r001.pack|npc_ie.bxon|31a3: "I wanted to fight alongside the hero, but I hurt my left knee and probably can't go into battle.

tm.「たとえ お前が 戦いの経験を重ねて\n どれだけ 強くなったとしても 油断する: "No matter how strong you've become from battle experience, don't let your guard down. That carelessness can be fatal.
tm.「危ないと思ったら 意地を張らず 逃げちまえ。\n 誰も お前のことを 笑ったり: "If it looks dangerous, don't be stubborn, just run. Nobody will laugh at you. Life is worth more than pride.
tm.「いやあ {var:1} よくやった！\n 魔物の親玉を 倒しちまうなんて\n: "Hey, {var:1}, well done! Defeating the monsters' boss, that's something!
tm.「まさか このイシの村から\n 世界を救う者が 現れるなんてな！\n オレも 自: "Who'd have thought someone who'd save the world would come from Cobblestone! I'm as happy as if it were me!
tm.「じつは オレ エマちゃんのこと好きで\n {var:1}が 彼女と結婚してから: "Actually I liked Gemma, and I felt a bit jealous after {var:1} married her.
tm.「でも 今のお前なら\n 素直に 自分の負けを認められるよ。\n 絶対 彼女を幸: "But now I can admit defeat honestly. Make sure you make her happy!
tm.「まいったな……倉庫に\n 予備の釣り針を しまっておいたんだが\n これじゃあ: "Oh dear... I kept spare fishing hooks in the storehouse, but now I'll never find them.
tm.「こんな時でも 気晴らしは大事だぞ。\n 心に余裕がなくなると 仕事をしていても: "Even at times like this, relaxation matters. When you have no slack, you make more mistakes at work.
tm.「ようやく 村の復興も 落ち着いて\n ゆっくりと 自分の時間が過ごせるわい。\: "The village's rebuilding finally settled down and I can spend time on myself. Ah, what peace...
tm.「この前 イシの村に来た\n 旅芸人さんは すごかったのう。\n 綱渡りをしたり: "That traveling performer who came to Cobblestone the other day was amazing. Walking the tightrope, breathing fire...
tm.「彼は お前さんの仲間だったんじゃろう？\n わしよりも カオが広くなっちまって: "He was your companion, wasn't he? You've got a wider circle than me now. You've grown while I wasn't looking.
tm.「この先にいらっしゃる テントの主は\n 命の大樹が 地に落ちた日から\n 病で: "The owner of the tent ahead has been bedridden with illness since the day the great tree fell.
